fusions.name: Skipping Rim
fusions.desc: Skims your shield at the first enemy in its path, dealing 7 damage, and it slips off to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of the original damage. It holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Bow Wave
fusions.desc: Sweeps your shield round through a wave of water, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocking them 2.5 tiles back. Each enemy hit is [Soaked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Slick Face
fusions.desc: For 6 seconds, blows slide off the wet face of your shield: 25% of the damage each one deals is sent back to whoever struck you.

fusions.name: Silver Scatter
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6. When you reach 6, they all spend at once: you move and attack 2% faster per stack (14% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds. Your armour is 5% higher.
